name: 淘内资源池 - 筛选专项(4筛选+7标签+重置)
description: 覆盖淘内资源池全部筛选功能：4个基础筛选(Seller ID/店铺名称/Item ID/图片ID)逐个填充验证+7维度标签点击筛选+标签选中/取消+重置按钮清空验证+筛选结果数量对比。

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder], input.ant-input'); const labels = document.querySelectorAll('label, .ant-form-item-label, [class*=label]'); const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button, .ant-btn'); return { inputCount: inputs.length, inputs: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,type:i.type})), labels: Array.from(labels).map(l=>l.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,15), hasReset: Array.from(btns).some(b=>/重置/.test(b.textContent)) }; })()
steps.description: 探查全部筛选组件: Input/Label/重置按钮
开始网络抓包-监控筛选API

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*=aifashion], img[src*=template], img[src*=oss]'); const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=card], [class*=thumb], [class*=item]'); return { initialImgCount: imgs.length, initialCardCount: cards.length }; })()
steps.description: 记录初始图片/卡片数量(筛选前基准)

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*=aifashion], img[src*=template], img[src*=oss]'); return { countAfterSellerFilter: imgs.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计Seller ID筛选后图片数量

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*=aifashion], img[src*=template], img[src*=oss]'); return { countAfterShopFilter: imgs.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计店铺名称筛选后图片数量

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder]'); const hasValue = Array.from(inputs).some(i => i.value && i.value.trim()); return { allCleared: !hasValue, inputValues: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,value:i.value})) }; })()
steps.description: 验证重置后所有筛选条件已清空

steps.expression: (() => { const dims = ['设计','搭配','拍摄','场景','光影','构图','视觉']; return dims.map(d => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=tag], .ant-tag, [class*=label], [class*=dimension]')).filter(el => el.textContent.includes(d)); return { dimension: d, found: els.length > 0, count: els.length }; }); })()
steps.description: 检查7个标签维度是否全部渲染

steps.expression: (() => { const tags = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=tag], .ant-tag, [class*=dimension]'); if(tags.length) { tags[0].click(); return { clicked: true, text: tags[0].textContent.trim(), class: tags[0].className?.substring(0,60) }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*=aifashion], img[src*=template], img[src*=oss]'); const active = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=active], [class*=checked], [class*=selected]'); return { countAfterTagFilter: imgs.length, activeTagCount: active.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证标签筛选效果: 图片数量变化+选中标签

steps.expression: (() => { const active = document.querySelector('[class*=tag][class*=active], .ant-tag-checkable-checked, [class*=selected]'); if(active) { active.click(); return { unclicked: true }; } return { unclicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 再次点击取消标签筛选

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*=aifashion], img[src*=template], img[src*=oss]'); return { countAfterCancel: imgs.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证取消标签后图片数量恢复

realDomNotes: 淘内资源池筛选专项: ①4个Input筛选(Seller ID/店铺名称/Item ID/图片ID, react:true) ②7维度标签点击筛选(设计/搭配/拍摄/场景/光影/构图/视觉) ③标签选中/取消 ④重置按钮清空所有筛选 ⑤每次筛选后对比图片数量验证效果。
preconditions: F88预发环境可访问，测试账号已登录，当前身份为F88，资源池存在模板数据
